explanation: He sailed to New York in 1920 with a troupe of acrobats and comedians, and took his new name with a studio contract in 1931. He became a US citizen in 1942.

claims.text: Cary Grant was born Archibald Leach in Bristol, England.
None of David Niven, Ray Milland and Ronald Colman was born Archibald Leach.
Archibald Leach sailed to New York in 1920 with Bob Pender's troupe of acrobats and comedians.
Archibald Leach took the name Cary Grant when he signed a studio contract in 1931.
Cary Grant became a United States citizen in 1942.

Volatility: evergreen; no time words; nothing depends on events after mid-2026. Regional: a Hollywood star known worldwide; the stem gives his birthplace, so no local knowledge is needed. Style: Oxford spelling, straight single quotes, plain hyphens, explanation of 32 words. Myths: claims screened against myths.json; no claim resembles a listed myth. Mystery and encore: not applicable to a practice item. Doubts: none beyond the high-risk claims flagged for external evidence.
